    about the project

    Evolution Residence is one of our most representative projects and a symbol of our success.

    The complex is a modern and recognizable residential space designed for individuals, families, and companies, with the goal of creating an exceptional environment for living, working, and leisure. Although still under construction, this unique project has already gained recognition due to high demand and dynamic sales.

    The high-quality apartments, business spaces, such as swimming pool, and a spa center will make the Evolution Residence complex the ideal place for living and working. The use of top-quality materials for finishing, combined with a beautiful location surrounded by greenery, will provide a high-quality living space with excellent connectivity to the city.

    Evolution Residence is located in Voždovac, at Tolminska St. №. 5-9.

    The Evolution Residence complex is located in a carefully selected area, offering easy access to the city center while being situated in a peaceful green oasis. With a total area of 57,302 m², the complex will consist of four residential-commercial buildings..

    materials

    TOP QUALITY FOR COMPLETE ENJOYMENT

    Aesthetics and Reliability in Every Detail

    High Quality and Exceptional Comfort

    The porcelain tiles in the hallways and stairwells will be selected to provide a modern and elegant appearance, in line with the overall style of the building. The doors to be installed will be of domestic production, equipped with a Grade III anti-burglary system, ensuring a high level of security for the residents. The interior doors will be MDF, finished with melamine treatment, combining durability and aesthetic appeal. The three-layer oak parquet, combined with white MDF baseboards of 6/8 cm height, will create a harmonious and contemporary interior. The spaces will feature first-class ceramic tiles from renowned European manufacturers, adding sophistication and comfort to every room.

    The building’s facade will be cladded with high-quality materials that will provide a long-lasting visual effect and an aesthetically pleasing appearance. Modern terraces with geometric shapes will contribute to the dynamism of the facade, while aluminum railings will add elegance and sophistication. Mosquito nets installed on the openings will be designed to allow for unobstructed ventilation, thus contributing to optimal air circulation. The central heating system with remote control and a calorimeter to monitor energy consumption, along with aluminum radiators and climate control systems, will ensure an optimal indoor climate, creating a comfortable atmosphere in all weather conditions.

    financing

    How to buy

    Credit

    Purchasing an apartment in the Evolution Residence housing complex can become a reality with the help of various banks offering favorable loans. Understanding the options available in the market will help you find the best solution for your financial needs.

    Buying an apartment on a loan can be a very smart decision for several reasons. First, a home loan allows you to become a property owner without the need to have the entire amount of money upfront. This means you can take advantage of current market opportunities and move into your home faster than if you were to wait until you save the required amount.

    Cash

    Purchasing an apartment in the Evolution Residence housing complex with cash can be an excellent choice for those who have the means. Paying in cash offers several advantages, including the ability to avoid interest payments and the convenience of a straightforward transaction process.

    Choosing to buy with cash means that you can enjoy the benefits of immediate ownership without the need to manage monthly loan repayments. This method not only simplifies the purchase process but also often provides more negotiating power, helping you secure the best possible deal on your new home.
